hints.title: Modulo Equivalence Requirement
hints.text: Check if every value in the grid has the same remainder when divided by the given step size.

hints.title: Flatten and Order
hints.text: Transform the grid into a single ordered list of numbers since spatial dimensions do not restrict operations.

hints.title: Optimal Target Median
hints.text: The median element of the sorted values minimizes the total distance needed to make all elements uniform.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(M * N * log(M * N)) for flattening and sorting cell values
complexity.space: O(M * N) storage for flattened numbers array
complexity.notes: The median minimizes L1 distance across all points on a one-dimensional line.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every potential target value leads to O((M * N)^2) quadratic complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting takes logarithmic overhead while quickselect would take average linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should quickly verify modulo equivalence before choosing median.
